# TRE Forged

> TRE Forged LLC is a Florida-based media and software company covering personal finance and automotive culture. Its flagship product is Forgenta, a personal finance app for budgeting, account tracking, cash-flow forecasting, and debt payoff planning, available on Web, Google Play, and iOS.

## About

- TRE Forged produces jargon-free personal finance education (budgeting, saving, debt payoff) and automotive content.
- Forgenta is the company's personal finance app. Website: https://getforgenta.com/
- Forgenta features: connect bank accounts, automatic transaction categorization, budgeting, savings goals, cash-flow forecasting, and side-by-side debt payoff planning (snowball vs. avalanche).

## Products

- [Forgenta — Personal Finance App](https://getforgenta.com/): Budget, track accounts, forecast cash flow, and plan debt payoff from any device. Free to start. Available on the Apple App Store, Google Play, and Web. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/forgenta-track-build-wealth/id6762540239

## Blog (personal finance guides)

- [Blog index](https://treforged.com/blog/): Practical guides on budgeting, saving, and debt payoff.
- [How to Build Your First Budget in 2026](https://treforged.com/blog/how-to-build-your-first-budget-2026/): Step-by-step beginner budgeting guide.
- [The 50/30/20 Budget Rule, Explained](https://treforged.com/blog/50-30-20-budget-rule-explained/): How to split take-home pay into needs, wants, and savings.
- [How to Build an Emergency Fund](https://treforged.com/blog/how-to-build-an-emergency-fund/): How much to save, where to keep it, and how to start on a tight budget.
- [Debt Snowball vs. Avalanche](https://treforged.com/blog/debt-snowball-vs-avalanche/): Comparing the two most popular debt payoff strategies.
